name: ThirdShotHub Pro Visor
description: The ThirdShotHub Pro Visor is an open-crown visor sized for outdoor play in flat midday light. The underbrim is a matte charcoal rather than the usual green, which cuts the upward glare off a light-colored court surround without the color cast a green underbrim puts on a yellow ball. The sweatband is a removable, washable terry insert instead of a sewn-in band.
care_instructions: Pull the terry insert and wash it separately; washing the visor body with the insert in place leaves salt deposits in the seam. Hand wash the body in cool water and reshape the brim while damp. Never put a visor in a dishwasher despite the common advice — the heat cycle warps the brim core permanently.
